_doc: Known gaps of the headless game host (the referee: full host and the stripped-down nodeless host) and of setups no real run has.
tools/fidelity/lab_groups.py marks a group host_suspect when its signature matches an entry, so a rule probe checks it before anyone fixes the emulator.
How it was built: by hand, from every referee/FINDINGS.md entry that names a driver or host gap, a full-host or nodeless artefact, a stall,
an idle timeout or a plausibility flag (grep -n -i 'driver gap|host|nodeless|artifact|stall|idle_timeout|plausib' referee/FINDINGS.md).
Each entry cites its finding by date and a phrase that must still be in FINDINGS.md (lab_groups checks it and says which entries went stale).
Entries for gaps since fixed are kept with status fixed: a match is then a regression suspect of the driver, still probe first.
match: entities are kind:ID keys (card, relic, potion, power, enemy, encounter); a group matches when it implicates one of them and,
when phases or fields are given, its first wrong step's phase and field are among them; errors and text match an example's error
or first-event text. Beyond the entries, lab_groups applies three generic rules: every example flagged cross_act, cross_character or
duplicate_relic (no real run holds the setup); the game's state standing still across the next plays (a stale snapshot, the night04
end_turn finding); and a trace re-run that does not reproduce the batch (a game-side flake).

also.quote: the driver's Idle settles before the game finishes its player turn start

entries.why: the game stood still at a start-of-turn auto-play or Rolling Boulder's awaited VFX, so the game side was a stale snapshot (driver Idle fixed in bd68419; check the record is settled)
the trace says the game's record was taken before its turn start finished

finding.quote: a full-host artifact, not an emulator divergence

entries.why: on the full host CardCmd.Transform of a hand card throws in its UI block and skips the rest of the method; the full host cannot referee it
a nodeless attempt played on past a fallback model and left the turn flags set; later fights in that process timed out

finding.quote: the 29 fights the two hosts recorded differently

entries.why: the full host generates the room-end rewards (Niche draws, flashes) at the last step and the nodeless host did not

finding.quote: Driver gaps: 2 idle timeouts in 120 fights

entries.why: setup fights timed out idle after these plays (driver), and a script-mode reproduction timed out under load
the game's hand layout threw with a hand over the limit, then stalled; game edge case or driver, not settled

also.quote: Attempting to initialize the wrong RID

entries.why: dummy-renderer and boot crashes of the headless game: an engine quirk, not a rule

finding.quote: PunchOff's endless animation loop never yields in Instant fast mode

entries.why: the driver enters ? rooms in Fast mode because PunchOff never yields in Instant mode

finding.quote: a reward that opens Scroll Boxes' choose-a-bundle screen while it is being taken

entries.why: reward screens opened while a reward was taken stalled the driver (fixed: the reward waits answer open screens)
